source.robot_pose_frame: i611 pose frame; exact active tool is not encoded in robot.json
source.depth_usage: hashed and audited, not used in RGB corner/PnP calibration

split.policy: Existing common simulation held-out IDs 2,5,9,12; near-pose groups checked before fitting

prior_fixed_estimates.meaning: September 10 moving gripper-board full-data fixed-camera estimates

definitions.heldout: Mean fixed-board base-pose chain residual across held-out event-camera observations; cam0/1/3 and cam2 are all fitted on fixedBoard train only.
definitions.camera_pose: Equal-camera macro discrepancy between calibrated camera poses and fixed-board PnP reference poses; not physical GT.
definitions.registration: Equal-pair macro discrepancy between calibrated relative cameras and same-event fixed-board PnP relative cameras; not physical GT.
definitions.reprojection: Corner-pooled held-out RMSE from frozen train calibration; sqrt(sum(||duv||^2)/N corners).
definitions.cross_view_reprojection: Both directions pooled for each available camera pair using source PnP and calibrated relative camera transform.

assumptions: Only the separate prior-comparison diagnostic assumes unchanged fixed-camera mounts between September 9 and September 10; metadata cannot prove this.
robot.json identifies an i611 pose but does not encode the exact active tool; the recorded pose frame is assumed rigidly attached to cam2.
Camera mapping follows the user-confirmed RealSense fixed order 0,1,3 and gripper camera 2.
Current intrinsics are matched by confirmed camera identity and resolution; capture-time intrinsic hashes are unavailable.
No corner-count/reprojection quality threshold, synthetic noise, robust loss, or outlier removal was used.
Depth PNGs are preserved and hashed but excluded because depth scale and RGB-depth alignment metadata are absent.
